content.short: iZiSwap is a multi-chain decentralized exchange featuring innovative DL-AMM for high capital efficiency.
content.description: iZiSwap is a sophisticated decentralized exchange protocol that introduces Discretized Liquidity Automated Market Maker (DL-AMM) technology to the Web3 landscape. By enabling liquidity providers to concentrate their capital at specific price points, iZiSwap significantly enhances capital efficiency and reduces slippage for traders compared to traditional AMMs. The platform supports seamless trading across multiple blockchain networks, providing users with deep liquidity and a professional-grade experience. iZiSwap focuses on providing a secure, non-custodial, and highly scalable environment, making it a foundational building block for decentralized finance innovation and liquidity management across the multichain ecosystem.
content.meta: iZiSwap is a leading multi-chain DEX featuring DL-AMM technology for high-efficiency trading and optimized liquidity management.
